title: RC-28: the test DB helper hand-writes a two-table schema at user_version 4 and claims it "matches src/utils/db.ts exactly"; production migrates to version 7 with lp_baseline, chain_state, pause_state and the exit_state failed-held columns, and the migration tests (unit and the pauseFlow integration suite) run hand-written replicas instead of migrateSchema

evidence.note: header: "Creates a fresh database with the full production schema (user_version=4)"
doc comment: "Schema matches src/utils/db.ts exactly" and "user_version = 4"
creates only trades and exit_state (exit_state without exit_failure_count / exit_status); no lp_baseline, chain_state or pause_state
v5: lp_baseline and chain_state tables (missing from the helper)
v6: pause_state (single row CHECK(id = 1)) and chain_state.antirug_dry_run_started (missing from the helper)
v7: exit_state.exit_failure_count and exit_state.exit_status (the exit_failed_held marker) (missing from the helper)
migrateSchema() writes user_version 7 and runs at import; it is not exported, so no test can run it without importing the live-DB singleton

evidence.ref: git grep -n createTestDb 23a64617dca167976adc4645fed0e2c69e384820 -- test src scripts
evidence.note: consumers at the base SHA: test/unit/db.test.ts (33 cases), test/unit/helpers.smoke.test.ts, test/unit/riskManager.test.ts (imported at :6); no integration or fork test uses the helper

applyV1Migration .. applyV6Migration are hand copies; buildV6Db stops at user_version 6 (:134): the v7 exit_state columns are absent
Tests 1-4 ("setPauseState writes a row", "restart simulation", "clearPauseState flips") prepare their own UPDATE/SELECT text (:163-166, :190-191, :219-225), not the db.ts statements
the production getPauseState / setPauseState / clearPauseState statements, never executed by any integration test (pauseFlow Tests 5-8 and pauseCli mock them)
createMockExitStateRow (used by test/unit/exitEngine.test.ts:348, :355) has the v3 exit_state shape: no exit_failure_count, no exit_status

sibling_sites_checked: Every schema copy in the TESTI slice at the base SHA (grep CREATE TABLE, user_version, ALTER TABLE over the snapshot): test/helpers/testDb.ts (v4, two tables) and test/integration/pauseFlow.test.ts:31-136 (v6 replica) are the only two; no fork test builds a schema (the fork tests that touch the DB import src/utils/db with a temp DB_PATH, see Task 2 rows). Fixture rows shaped like DB rows: exitEngine.fixtures.ts createMockExitStateRow (pre-v7), api.fixtures.ts createMockTradeRow (trades subset, no status-failed or exit_state join). The unit-side copies (db.test.ts SQL copies, db/*Migration.test.ts replicas, the v4 pins) are TESTU scope and registered as AUD-TESTU-017/-018/-019.
severity_rationale: S2 as the research suggests: test/infra drift that can hide an S0/S1. The helper is the only shared test DB and it cannot hold a failed-held position or a pause row, so the registered S1 AUD-DB-003 (failed-held positions drop out of every risk limit) and the kill-switch persistence are untestable on it; the replica migrations would pass a broken migrateSchema. Capital class OVERSPEND because the hidden defects are risk-limit overspend.
recommendation: Phase 28: build the test DB from the production migration (the dbSchema.ts module the 22-09 relocation creates), assert user_version equals CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, delete the hand schema and the pauseFlow replica, and give pauseFlow Tests 1-4 the real setPauseState / getPauseState / clearPauseState statements on a temp DB. Update createMockExitStateRow to the v7 shape. Phase 23 can use the same temp-DB-from-migrateSchema harness for its real-path triage.
affected_cases: pauseFlow Test 1: setPauseState writes a row visible to getPauseState with paused=1 + audit columns populated
pauseFlow Test 2: restart simulation — setPauseState → db.close() → reopen → row still present
pauseFlow Test 3: clearPauseState flips paused 1 → 0 AND nulls all audit columns
pauseFlow Test 4: single-row constraint enforced — cannot INSERT id=2 (CHECK(id=1))
escaped_regression: Delete the v7 block of migrateSchema (src/utils/db.ts:194-230) or the v6 pause_state INSERT OR IGNORE (:181): a fresh production DB then has no exit_status column (every failed-held write throws) or no pause row (setPauseState updates zero rows, so the kill switch silently does nothing), and every helper-based unit test and pauseFlow Tests 1-4 stay green because they build their own schema.

sub_claims.claim: Helper schema and version drift: testDb.ts builds trades + exit_state at user_version 4 while production is user_version 7 with three more tables and two more exit_state columns.

The drift hides capital-relevant behaviour: a failed-held position (exit_state.exit_status = exit_failed_held, the row the risk queries drop, AUD-DB-003) and the kill-switch row (pause_state) cannot be expressed in the helper DB, so no helper-based test can put one through a production statement.

Migration tests mirror instead of run: the integration pauseFlow suite rebuilds V1..V6 by hand (stopping at 6) and asserts on its own SQL; the unit migration tests do the same (registered as AUD-TESTU-019).
Fixture drift: the exit_state row fixture used by the exit-engine unit tests has the pre-v7 shape.

triage.note: Sub-claims 1 and 2 fixed by this phase's CHAR-05 helper swap (23-03, b6c4de4: createTestDb built by the real migrations, so a failed-held exit and a pause row can be expressed); sub-claims 3 and 4 fixed by 23-14 (0ca1e01) under the operator ruling Fix now (Recommended) on the 23-14 checkpoint: the pauseFlow hand-built v6 schema copy is deleted and its Tests 1-4 run the real pause statements on the real migrations, and createMockExitStateRow has the version 7 shape pinned to the migrated table; a revert of pauseFlow.test.ts to a hand-built copy is caught by no test (a test cannot guard its own text), only by review, since any later edit needs a reviewed re_audit row (check.ts --stage final); the unit-test migration replicas are the separate entry AUD-TESTU-019, left open for Phase 28 and not touched here; status confirmed -> fixed
